title: 实现打包与发布证据闭环
risks: Real Windows SCM, Docker daemon and Linux systemd lifecycle evidence has not been executed; the security-hardened orchestration, static policy checks and native Windows process smoke cannot close those platform gates.

Windows Administrator-owned staging/LocalService execution and Linux root-owned staging/non-root systemd execution are covered by static and unit regressions but still require runtime proof on isolated target machines.

The host exposes only host-level health, readiness and build information; authentication, database runtime composition, business APIs, TLS/secrets, upgrades, rollback and a production installer remain V01-009 or later work.
Docker non-root/read-only/restart/down-v behavior and Linux systemd hardening/cleanup remain unproven on their real target runtimes.
Production physical writes remain disabled and M0-006-G1/G2/G3 remain open; these artifacts must not be presented as a releasable Alpha.
blocked_by: windows_service: blocked_missing_environment because the current Codex session is non-elevated and system changes are forbidden; an approved snapshot-capable Windows VM SCM cycle is required.
docker: blocked_missing_environment because no usable Docker CLI/daemon exists on the current runner; a real daemon cycle is required.
linux_systemd: blocked_missing_environment because no approved Linux systemd/root runner is available; a real unit lifecycle is required.

architecture_review.module: Single cross-platform CoreServer host adapter plus Windows, Linux and Docker release evidence tooling
reused_existing_logic: The existing AssetLibrary.CoreServer assembly remains the only business core; the new host only composes its public boundary.
M0-004 configuration validation, loopback health probe, fixed source revision, deterministic cold publish, owner marker and zero-residue evidence patterns.
V01-001 .NET 10 central package, locked restore, analyzer, vulnerability, license and source-policy toolchain.
Existing V01-006/V01-007 public contracts are left unchanged and no production-write adapter is composed.
The release builder reuses Git archive snapshots, exact issuance-input policy and complete artifact-tree digests instead of creating a parallel provenance mechanism.
duplicated_logic: Configuration, health payload, manifest, archive and provenance invariants are intentionally revalidated at process, packaging, privileged-orchestration and independent-validator trust boundaries; no business rule is duplicated.
cross_module_access: AssetLibrary.CoreServer.Host references the public AssetLibrary.CoreServer project only and does not access module Infrastructure, tables or internal entities.
Windows Service, systemd and Docker differences remain in Host lifecycle and infra release definitions; the business assembly and host project are shared.
Contracts, migrations, generated SDKs, GatewayAuth, LibraryStorage, AssetIdentity, ScanReconciliation, TaskHealth, TransferSync and OperationTrash implementations are unchanged.
Production file writes, Provider loading, Explorer integration and network business APIs are absent from the release composition.
new_major_dependencies: Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting.WindowsServices 10.0.11 (MIT), used only by the host adapter for Windows SCM lifecycle integration; Microsoft.Extensions dependency abstractions are centrally aligned at 10.0.11.
contract_changes: Adds the host/release evidence contract v01-008/1 for health, host-only readiness, build information, artifact manifests and platform evidence states.
No shared wire schema, database migration, AssetLink contract, generated SDK or unified error-code contract changed.
architecture_tests: 18 targeted Packaging MSTest cases and the complete 185-test .NET solution with locked restore, format, Release build, dependency/source policy and vulnerability report.
19 release tests plus two commit-snapshot cold publishes, complete manifest/archive validation and a final native win-x64 process lifecycle smoke.

Security regressions cover isolated Python, exact MSBuild inputs, ancestor/import override rejection, secure Windows/Linux staging, non-privileged HTTP health polling, no-follow handles, Windows path aliases and archive snapshot parsing.
53 database tests including 14 PostgreSQL 16.15 integration cases, 48 repository tests and 14 architecture tests.
14 SDK Python and 21 AssetLink contract/spike tests, TypeScript SDK 5/5, Kotlin/JVM build and six Chromium Web regressions.
v0.1-start allow gate and expected windows-server-release/docker-release/linux-server-release/production-file-writes/v0.1-release deny gates.
technical_debt: Run and independently review the Windows SCM cycle on YOKICESHI, the Docker cycle on a real daemon and the systemd cycle on an approved Linux runner before changing platform gate state.
V01-009 must integrate authentication, PostgreSQL runtime/migrations, business APIs, TLS/secrets and upgrade/rollback without splitting the business core.
Design production installer, signing/SBOM/provenance publication and release rollback only in separately scoped release work.
Keep production physical writes disabled until M0-006-G1/G2/G3 evidence and approvals are complete.
